vocabulary.def: a link sent to an e-mail that lets one person join one workspace

stories.name: Send an invite
stories.so: that they join without me creating the account

acs.text: GIVEN an admin on the invite form WHEN they submit an e-mail THEN a link valid for 7 calendar days is sent AND the invite shows as pending
GIVEN the e-mail is already a member WHEN the admin submits it THEN the form shows a hint AND nothing is sent

badPaths.behavior: the first pending invite is resent, no second one
the invite stays pending and the admin sees 'not sent yet'

out: choosing a role at invite time (S-003, later)

stories.name: Accept an invite
stories.want: to open the link and set my password
stories.so: that I am in the workspace

acs.text: GIVEN a valid link WHEN the person opens it and sets a password THEN they are logged in to the workspace
GIVEN an expired link WHEN the person opens it THEN the page says it expired AND offers nothing else

badPaths.behavior: second open says the invite was already used
an error page; the link stays valid
whoever opens it first gets the account; risk accepted

inferred.assumed: seven calendar days, not business days
